agent.reasons: The entity is an MSB, a restricted industry that 5.2 would normally escalate. Section 5.3 makes an exception: a licensed MSB whose state licence has been verified may be approved, and this licence is verified. The control person (Sven Yilmaz, CEO) is identified, the 43% and 36% owners are identified and ownership adds up to 100%, all three individuals' IDs are verified, and the registry filing (2026-01-11) is less than 12 months old. Sanctions, PEP and adverse media checks are all clear, and every party is in the US, so no risk factor applies.
